why: Three refusal messages left the source in 0.8.0. The migration note was complete and the change was right; nothing would have noticed if it had not been. This file makes a member leaving, arriving or being reworded show up in the diff, where review sees it. Its only job is review.
not_a_contract: These messages are not a contract and this file does not make them one. No consumer may match on a refusal message: ADR-0095 and ADR-0096 both say so, and the adapter's own comments record that a message is a value from a closed table, selected by equality against the source token and never built from it -- which is a privacy property, not a stability promise. Updating this file is the correct fix for the test that reads it.
update: When a table changes, run the extraction in tests/test_refusal_message_golden.py (`_messages_by_table`) and write the result here, in the same pull request as the message change. Never loosen the test instead.
